description: Copeland (formerly Emerson Climate Technologies) scroll compressors for ductable, package and precision AC units.

series.name: ZR scroll
series.description: Copeland's long-running scroll range for R22 and R407C systems. The number in the model code is the nominal cooling capacity in thousands of BTU/h (ZR81 ≈ 81,000 BTU/h).
power_supply: PFJ: 220–240 V, single-phase, 50 Hz (smaller K3 models)
features: Compliant scroll design tolerates liquid and debris better than reciprocating compressors
Fewer moving parts, lower noise and vibration
Common replacement in ductable, package and precision AC units

series.name: ZP scroll
series.description: Copeland's scroll range for R410A systems, used in newer ductable, package and rooftop units. The model number is the nominal capacity in thousands of BTU/h.
power_supply: PFV: 220–240 V, single-phase, 50 Hz (smaller K5E models)
features: Designed for the higher pressures of R410A
Uses POE oil, as required for HFC refrigerants
Common in newer ductable, package and rooftop units
